first_handback:
The report is at /private/tmp/murmuration-w04/author-w04-2/runs/u-a3/lab/__reports__/wave-04/explorer-w04-ua3/00-findings_v0.md. I read all 90 files in order, one `cat` per call. The Table has one row per file, each with file name, station name, founding year and founder.

Station names are not unique. 22 names recur across the files, always with a different founder or year. Slatemoor in f003 and f005 has the same year (1945) but different founders. Moormere appears four times (f042, f045, f069, f072). I treated each file as a distinct station and flagged this in the report as the worst-fitting case, with a steering question.

Not covered: height, population, trade and wind saying, which the brief did not ask for. No helper scripts were written.

My puzzles are in /private/tmp/murmuration-w04/author-w04-2/runs/u-a3/lab/__scrupuli__/wave-04-explorer-w04-ua3.md.
